beats.purpose: Introduce one teal square as a small idea in a spacious, paper-colored world. Let the camera begin its journey before the next beat.
Round the original square into the center of an unfolding network. Connections grow from it while the same world pulls back and turns.

handoff.reason: The same visible seed moves and scales continuously through 3.8–4.2 seconds as the camera pulls back and its connections unfold; it is never replaced.

beats.purpose: Carry the network center across the frame and turn it into a diamond emblem. Its existing satellite nodes become radial signal marks, then the film breathes.

handoff.reason: The original hub travels left and rotates through 7.8–8.2 seconds while the network gathers into a signal. The carrier and its parent world retain their DOM identities.
